channel.title: The New York Times International Edition - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The New York Times International Edition (nytimes.com)

item.title: College Graduates Are Facing the Grimmest Job Market in Years
item.description: Artificial intelligence could reshape work, but for now a low-hire, low-fire labor market is the main impediment for young people seeking employment.

item.title: Wicked Stepmother No Longer, a Female Pharoah Gets a Reputational Makeover
item.description: A reassessment of damaged 3,500-year-old statuary adds to evidence that Queen Hatshepsut wasn’t the villain that scholars long took her to be.

item.title: Israel Plans to Control Large Parts of Southern Lebanon, Defense Minister Says
item.description: Israel Katz, the Israeli defense minister, suggested that Israeli troops might remain in parts of Lebanon even after the fighting there winds down.

item.title: Fresh Food Distributors Add Surcharges as Fuel Costs Rise
item.description: Delivering salmon, fruits and other perishable foods has become more expensive as the war with Iran pushes up diesel prices.

item.title: U.S. Gas Prices Hit $4 a Gallon on Average
item.description: A month since the first U.S.-Israeli attacks and Iran’s response effectively shut off Persian Gulf oil, drivers are paying significantly more to fill up.

item.title: Offensive vs. Defensive: On Iran, the Distinction Matters for Britain’s Leader
item.description: As the United States expands its armada of warplanes on British soil, Prime Minister Keir Starmer says he is trying to defend Britain’s interests while keeping the country out of war.
